observations.posthog_connection: Changes the resume state storage for Aviator warehouse ingestion. The checkpoint records batcher state alongside the completed repo, allowing recovery to skip rows already held by the batcher rather than re-processing them. This could reduce duplicate ingestion and recovery time after a crash.
